# Alignment

```{bash, eval=FALSE}

##########################################################################################################################################
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# =======================
# Configuration
# =======================

REFERENCE=/mnt/disks/data1/References/Cell_Ranger/refdata-gex-mm10-2020-A
FASTQ_DIR=/mnt/disks/data1/Jia_GEO_submission
SAMPLE=1538CreTE10HE13_cDNA
THREADS=15
MEM=120

# =======================
# Logging & checks
# =======================

echo "======================================"
echo "Starting Cell Ranger run"
echo "Sample:        ${SAMPLE}"
echo "FASTQ dir:     ${FASTQ_DIR}"
echo "Reference:     ${REFERENCE}"
echo "Cores:         ${THREADS}"
echo "Memory (GB):   ${MEM}"
echo "======================================"
date

# Sanity check FASTQs
ls -lh ${FASTQ_DIR}/*1538CreTE10HE13*_R1_*.fastq.gz
ls -lh ${FASTQ_DIR}/*1538CreTE10HE13*_R2_*.fastq.gz

# =======================
# Cell Ranger count
# =======================

cellranger count \
  --id=${SAMPLE} \
  --fastqs=${FASTQ_DIR} \
  --sample=122220_1538CreTE10HE13_cDNA \
  --transcriptome=${REFERENCE} \
  --localcores=${THREADS} \
  --localmem=${MEM}

echo "======================================"
echo "Cell Ranger completed successfully"
date
```

# Cell IDs sanity check

```{r}

# Full Integrated Seurat object from the original submission
# Full original integrated UMAP
pbmc <- readRDS("C:/Users/karol/Box/Nord_Lab_Computational_Projects3/Jia_E13_1538_Aug_2023/seurat_objects/MGE_1538_E11_and_E13_with_new_E13.Rds")

DimPlot(pbmc, label = T, label.size = 10)

# Task: Check if cell IDs in the Seurat object match the realigned datasets. This is a sanity check making sure that we are uploading correct files to GEO.

cell_ids_by_dataset <- split(
  colnames(pbmc),
  pbmc$dataset
)

cell_ids_by_dataset



list.files("C:/Users/karol/Box/Nord_Lab_Computational_Projects3/Jia_E13_1538_Aug_2023/GEO_submission/cellranger_rerun_Jan_2026")


```


```{r}

base_dir <- "C:/Users/karol/Box/Nord_Lab_Computational_Projects3/Jia_E13_1538_Aug_2023/GEO_submission/cellranger_rerun_Jan_2026"

datasets <- list.files(base_dir)
datasets
# [1] "1538CreTE10HE13_cDNA" "JH4327_01" "Rubenstein-JH-3829-GEX-02"


library(Seurat)

seurat_cr <- lapply(datasets, function(ds) {

  message("Reading: ", ds)

  data_dir <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    ds,
    "outs",
    "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"
  )

  counts <- Read10X(data.dir = data_dir)

  CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = counts,
    project = ds,
    assay = "RNA"
  )
})

names(seurat_cr) <- datasets

```


```{r}

cell_ids_cellranger <- lapply(seurat_cr, colnames)

names(cell_ids_cellranger)
# "1538CreTE10HE13_cDNA"
# "JH4327_01"
# "Rubenstein-JH-3829-GEX-02"

length(cell_ids_cellranger$JH4327_01)
head(cell_ids_cellranger$JH4327_01)

```


Cell ID matching
```{r}
#### JH4327_01 ###

JH4327_01_Seurat_IDs <- cell_ids_by_dataset$JH4327_01_TE10H13
JH4327_01_realigned_IDs <- cell_ids_cellranger$JH4327_01

head(JH4327_01_Seurat_IDs)
head(JH4327_01_realigned_IDs)


length(JH4327_01_Seurat_IDs)
length(JH4327_01_realigned_IDs)

any(duplicated(JH4327_01_Seurat_IDs))
any(duplicated(JH4327_01_realigned_IDs))

####

ids_seurat <- unique(JH4327_01_Seurat_IDs)
ids_realigned <- unique(JH4327_01_realigned_IDs)

overlap_ids <- intersect(ids_seurat, ids_realigned)

length(ids_seurat)
length(ids_realigned)
length(overlap_ids)

# proportions
length(overlap_ids) / length(ids_seurat)
length(overlap_ids) / length(ids_realigned)

library(eulerr)

euler_obj <- euler(
  list(
    "Seurat (integrated)" = ids_seurat,
    "Cell Ranger (realigned)" = ids_realigned
  )
)


plot(
  euler_obj,
  fills = c("#4C72B0", "#DD8452"),
  edges = TRUE,
  quantities = TRUE,
  main = "JH4327_01: Seurat vs Realigned Cell Ranger Barcodes"
)

```


```{r}
### TE10H11 ###

TE10H11_Seurat_IDs <- cell_ids_by_dataset$`1538TE10H11`
TE10H11_realigned_IDs <- cell_ids_cellranger$`Rubenstein-JH-3829-GEX-02`

head(TE10H11_Seurat_IDs)
head(TE10H11_realigned_IDs)

## Strip Seurat merge suffix (_1)
TE10H11_Seurat_IDs_clean <- sub("_\\d+$", "", TE10H11_Seurat_IDs)

head(TE10H11_Seurat_IDs_clean)

## Basic checks
length(TE10H11_Seurat_IDs_clean)
length(TE10H11_realigned_IDs)

any(duplicated(TE10H11_Seurat_IDs_clean))
any(duplicated(TE10H11_realigned_IDs))

## Define unique sets
ids_seurat <- unique(TE10H11_Seurat_IDs_clean)
ids_realigned <- unique(TE10H11_realigned_IDs)

## Overlap
overlap_ids <- intersect(ids_seurat, ids_realigned)

length(ids_seurat)
length(ids_realigned)
length(overlap_ids)

## Proportions
length(overlap_ids) / length(ids_seurat)
length(overlap_ids) / length(ids_realigned)

## Euler diagram
library(eulerr)

euler_obj <- euler(
  list(
    "Seurat (integrated)" = ids_seurat,
    "Cell Ranger (realigned)" = ids_realigned
  )
)

plot(
  euler_obj,
  fills = c("#4C72B0", "#DD8452"),
  edges = TRUE,
  quantities = TRUE,
  main = "1538TE10H11: Seurat vs Realigned Cell Ranger Barcodes"
)



```
